_comment: MCP servers bridged into the agent via the native bridge (agent/mcp/bridge.ts), which uses the official @modelcontextprotocol/sdk. Same format as pi-mcp-adapter (.pi/mcp.json). The agent sees ONE ~200-token `mcp` proxy tool (list/search/describe/call); set a server's directTools to promote specific tools to first-class instead.

browser39._note: browser39's 29 interactive tools (fetch/click/fill/submit/dom_query/session). Tools are already `browser39_`-prefixed, so toolPrefix is 'none' to avoid double-prefixing. Plain page reads go through the <browse> action; reach for these when a page needs interaction.
